decisions.reason: As a GIS solution-building platform closely aligned with our core enterprise geospatial know-how, reusable architectures, and R&D capabilities, it fits our absorptive capacity well and is worth retaining despite some portfolio-risk uncertainty.

Mobile field data capture is adjacent to our established mobile and GIS integration competencies and serves clear customer process needs, so we are well placed to learn from deployments and improve it rather than withdraw it.

Although search extensions are more vulnerable to pruning because they are narrower add-ons, this product remained visible with a version update and still builds strongly on our web-map expertise, so we would keep it for now while monitoring demand.
